body.en: Unit Circle Periodicity, Harmonic Synthesis & Triangle Laws: Every angle \(\theta\) on the unit circle defines \((\cos\theta, \sin\theta)\) with fundamental Pythagorean invariance \(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta \equiv 1\). Linear combinations of同-frequency waves \(a\cos\theta \pm b\sin\theta\) collapse into a single phase-shifted sinusoid \(R\cos(\theta \mp \alpha)\) where \(R = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}\) and \(\tan\alpha = b/a\), immediately revealing the exact maximum \(+R\) and minimum \(-R\).
body.ar: Unit الدائرة Periodicity, Harmonic Synthesis & المثلث Laws: Every الزاوية \(\theta\) on the unit الدائرة defines \((\cos\theta, \sin\theta)\) with fundamental Pythagorean invariance \(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta \equiv 1\). Linear combinations of同-frequency waves \(a\cos\theta \pm b\sin\theta\) collapse into a single phase-shifted sinusoid \(R\cos(\theta \mp \alpha)\) حيث \(R = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}\) and \(\tan\alpha = b/a\), immediately revealing the exact maximum \(+R\) and minimum \(-R\).

body.en:
Calculator in Radian mode: Formulas \(s = r\theta\), \(A = \tfrac{1}{2}r^2\theta\), and \(A_{\Delta} = \tfrac{1}{2}r^2\sin\theta\) are strictly valid only when \(\theta\) is in radians. If your calculator is in degree mode when evaluating \(\sin(1.2)\), you will evaluate the sine of \(1.2^\circ\) instead of \(1.2\text{ rad}\), wiping out all accuracy marks.

Perimeter of a sector: The perimeter of a sector consists of the curved arc length PLUS the two straight radii: \(P = r\theta + 2r\). Overlooking the two radii (\(+2r\)) is the single most common slip in Cambridge circular measure questions.

Major vs Minor: Always double check whether the question specifies the minor or major segment/sector. For the major sector, the central angle is \(2\pi - \theta\).
body.ar:
Calculator in Radian mode: الصيغ \(s = r\theta\), \(A = \tfrac{1}{2}r^2\theta\), and \(A_{\Delta} = \tfrac{1}{2}r^2\sin\theta\) are strictly valid only عندما \(\theta\) is in radians. If your calculator is in degree mode عندما evaluating \(\sin(1.2)\), you will احسب قيمة sine of \(1.2^\circ\) instead of \(1.2\text{ rad}\), wiping out all accuracy marks.

Perimeter of a sector: The المحيط of a sector consists of the curved arc length PLUS the two straight radii: \(P = r\theta + 2r\). Overlooking the two radii (\(+2r\)) is the single most common slip in Cambridge circular measure questions.

Major vs Minor: Always double check whether the question specifies the minor or major segment/sector. For the major sector, the central الزاوية is \(2\pi - \theta\).

body.en:
Why the Harmonic \(R\)-Formula & Cosine Rule Hold: Expanding \(R\cos(\theta - \alpha)\) via the compound-angle identity gives:

\[ R\cos(\theta - \alpha) = (R\cos\alpha)\cos\theta + (R\sin\alpha)\sin\theta \]

Matching coefficients with \(a\cos\theta + b\sin\theta\) requires \(R\cos\alpha = a\) and \(R\sin\alpha = b\). Squaring and adding yields \(R^2(\cos^2\alpha + \sin^2\alpha) = a^2 + b^2 \implies R = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}\), and dividing gives \(\tan\alpha = \dfrac{b}{a}\).
body.ar:
Why the Harmonic \(R\)-الصيغة & Cosine Rule Hold: Expanding \(R\cos(\theta - \alpha)\) via the compound-الزاوية المتطابقة gives:

\[ R\cos(\theta - \alpha) = (R\cos\alpha)\cos\theta + (R\sin\alpha)\sin\theta \]

Matching المعاملات with \(a\cos\theta + b\sin\theta\) requires \(R\cos\alpha = a\) and \(R\sin\alpha = b\). Squaring and adding yields \(R^2(\cos^2\alpha + \sin^2\alpha) = a^2 + b^2 \implies R = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}\), and dividing gives \(\tan\alpha = \dfrac{b}{a}\).

body.en:
Problem (Easy): The diagram shows a sector of a circle with radius \(r\). The angle at the centre is \(\theta\) radians. If the arc length is \(6\) cm and the radius is \(3\) cm, find the angle \(\theta\) in radians.

Step-by-Step Solution: **Mark Scheme (CAIE / Edexcel Grading Steps):** - **Step 1 (Method & Formulation):** Identify the required geometric/algebraic relationship from the diagram and substitute the given values. **[M1]** - **Step 2 (Derivation & Calculation):** The formula relating arc length (\(s\)), radius (\(r\)), and angle (\(\theta\)) in radians is \(s = r\theta\). We are given \(s = 6\) cm and \(r = 3\) cm. Substituting these values into the formula, we get \(6 = 3\theta\). To find \(\theta\), we divide both sides by 3: \(\theta = \frac{6}{3} = 2\) radians. Therefore, the angle at the centre is \(2\) radians. **[M1]** - **Step 3 (Final Accuracy):** Verified exact result: \(2\) radians. **[A1]**
body.ar:
Problem (Easy): The المخطط shows a sector of a الدائرة with نصف القطر \(r\). The الزاوية at the centre is \(\theta\) radians. If the arc length is \(6\) cm and the نصف القطر is \(3\) cm, أوجد الزاوية \(\theta\) in radians.

Step-by-Step الحل: **Mark Scheme (CAIE / Edexcel Grading Steps):** - **الخطوة ١ (Method & Formulation):** Identify the required geometric/algebraic relationship from the المخطط and عوّض the المعطيات values. **[M1]** - **الخطوة ٢ (اشتقاق & Calculation):** The الصيغة relating arc length (\(s\)), نصف القطر (\(r\)), and الزاوية (\(\theta\)) in radians is \(s = r\theta\). We are المعطيات \(s = 6\) cm and \(r = 3\) cm. Substituting these values into the الصيغة, we get \(6 = 3\theta\). To find \(\theta\), we divide both sides by 3: \(\theta = \frac{6}{3} = 2\) radians. وبالتالي, the الزاوية at the centre is \(2\) radians. **[M1]** - **الخطوة ٣ (Final Accuracy):** Verified exact result: \(2\) radians. **[A1]**

body.en:
Problem (Medium): The diagram shows a sector of a circle with centre O. The arc length of the sector is given by \( 6 \pi \text{ cm} \) and the area of the sector is \( 27 \pi \text{ cm}^2 \). The radius of the circle is \( r \text{ cm} \) and the angle of the sector is \( \theta \text{ radians} \).

Find the value of \( r \) and \( \theta \).

Step-by-Step Solution: **Mark Scheme (CAIE / Edexcel Grading Steps):** - **Step 1 (Method & Formulation):** Identify the required geometric/algebraic relationship from the diagram and substitute the given values. **[M1]** - **Step 2 (Derivation & Calculation):** The formula for the arc length of a sector is \(L = r\theta\), where \(L\) is the arc length, \(r\) is the radius, and \(\theta\) is the angle in radians. We are given that \(L = 6\pi\). So, we have the equation:

\(r\theta = 6\pi\) (1)

The formula for the area of a sector is \(A = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\), where \(A\) is the area, \(r\) is the radius, and \(\theta\) is the angle in radians. We are given that \(A = 27\pi\). So, we have the equation:

\(\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = 27\pi\) (2)

We can rewrite equation (2) as \(r(r\theta) = 54\pi\).
Substitute equation (1) into this rewritten equation:

\(r(6\pi) = 54\pi\)

Divide both sides by \(6\pi\) to find \(r\):

\(r = \frac{54\pi}{6\pi} = 9\)

Now substitute the value of \(r\) back into equation (1) to find \(\theta\):

\(9\theta = 6\pi\)

Divide both sides by 9:

\(\theta = \frac{6\pi}{9} = \frac{2\pi}{3}\)

Therefore, \(r = 9\) cm and \(\theta = \frac{2\pi}{3}\) radians. **[M1]** - **Step 3 (Final Accuracy):** Verified exact result: r = 9, \( \theta = \frac{2\pi}{3} \). **[A1]**
body.ar:
Problem (Medium): The المخطط shows a sector of a الدائرة with centre O. The arc length of the sector is المعطيات by \( 6 \pi \text{ cm} \) and the المساحة of the sector is \( 27 \pi \text{ cm}^2 \). The نصف القطر of the الدائرة is \( r \text{ cm} \) and the الزاوية of the sector is \( \theta \text{ radians} \).

Find the value of \( r \) and \( \theta \).

Step-by-Step الحل: **Mark Scheme (CAIE / Edexcel Grading Steps):** - **الخطوة ١ (Method & Formulation):** Identify the required geometric/algebraic relationship from the المخطط and عوّض the المعطيات values. **[M1]** - **الخطوة ٢ (اشتقاق & Calculation):** The الصيغة for the arc length of a sector is \(L = r\theta\), حيث \(L\) is the arc length, \(r\) is the نصف القطر, and \(\theta\) is the الزاوية in radians. We are بما أن \(L = 6\pi\). So, we have the المعادلة:

\(r\theta = 6\pi\) (1)

The الصيغة for the المساحة of a sector is \(A = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\), حيث \(A\) is the المساحة, \(r\) is the نصف القطر, and \(\theta\) is the الزاوية in radians. We are بما أن \(A = 27\pi\). So, we have the المعادلة:

\(\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = 27\pi\) (2)

We can rewrite المعادلة (2) as \(r(r\theta) = 54\pi\).
Substitute المعادلة (1) into this rewritten المعادلة:

\(r(6\pi) = 54\pi\)

Divide both sides by \(6\pi\) to find \(r\):

\(r = \frac{54\pi}{6\pi} = 9\)

Now عوّض the value of \(r\) back into المعادلة (1) to find \(\theta\):

\(9\theta = 6\pi\)

Divide both sides by 9:

\(\theta = \frac{6\pi}{9} = \frac{2\pi}{3}\)

Therefore, \(r = 9\) cm and \(\theta = \frac{2\pi}{3}\) radians. **[M1]** - **الخطوة ٣ (Final Accuracy):** Verified exact result: r = 9, \( \theta = \frac{2\pi}{3} \). **[A1]**

question.en: A circle has radius \(8\text{ cm}\). A sector of this circle has a total perimeter of \(28\text{ cm}\). Find the angle of the sector in radians, and calculate the exact area of the sector.
question.ar: A circle has radius \(8\text{ cm}\). A sector of this circle has a total perimeter of \(28\text{ cm}\). أوجد angle of the sector in radians, and احسب exact area of the sector.

solution.en:
The perimeter of a sector is given by \(P = s + 2r = r\theta + 2r\).
Substitute \(P = 28\) and \(r = 8\): \[28 = 8\theta + 2(8) \Rightarrow 28 = 8\theta + 16 \Rightarrow 8\theta = 12 \Rightarrow \theta = \dfrac{12}{8} = 1.5\text{ radians}\] The area of the sector is: \[A = \dfrac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \dfrac{1}{2}(8^2)(1.5) = \dfrac{1}{2}(64)(1.5) = 32 \times 1.5 = 48\text{ cm}^2\]
solution.ar:
The perimeter of a sector is given by \(P = s + 2r = r\theta + 2r\).
عوّض \(P = 28\) and \(r = 8\): \[28 = 8\theta + 2(8) \Rightarrow 28 = 8\theta + 16 \Rightarrow 8\theta = 12 \Rightarrow \theta = \dfrac{12}{8} = 1.5\text{ radians}\] The area of the sector is: \[A = \dfrac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \dfrac{1}{2}(8^2)(1.5) = \dfrac{1}{2}(64)(1.5) = 32 \times 1.5 = 48\text{ cm}^2\]

question.en: In a circle of radius \(10\text{ cm}\), chord \(AB\) subtends an angle of \(\theta = \tfrac{2\pi}{3}\) radians at the centre \(O\). Find: (a) the exact length of chord \(AB\), (b) the exact area of the minor segment bounded by chord \(AB\) and minor arc \(AB\), in terms of \(\pi\) and \(\sqrt{3}\).
question.ar: In a circle of radius \(10\text{ cm}\), chord \(AB\) subtends an angle of \(\theta = \tfrac{2\pi}{3}\) radians at the centre \(O\). أوجد: (a) the exact length of chord \(AB\), (b) the exact area of the minor segment bounded by chord \(AB\) and minor arc \(AB\), in terms of \(\pi\) and \(\sqrt{3}\).

solution.en:
(a) Use the cosine rule in triangle \(OAB\) with \(OA = OB = 10\) and \(\angle AOB = \tfrac{2\pi}{3} = 120^\circ\): \[AB^2 = 10^2 + 10^2 - 2(10)(10)\cos\left(\tfrac{2\pi}{3}\right) = 100 + 100 - 200\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right) = 200 + 100 = 300\] Thus \(AB = \sqrt{300} = 10\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}\).
(b) Area of sector \(OAB\): \[A_{\text{sector}} = \dfrac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \dfrac{1}{2}(10^2)\left(\tfrac{2\pi}{3}\right) = \dfrac{100\pi}{3}\text{ cm}^2\] Area of triangle \(OAB\): \[A_{\Delta} = \dfrac{1}{2}r^2\sin\theta = \dfrac{1}{2}(10^2)\sin\left(\tfrac{2\pi}{3}\right) = 50\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) = 25\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}^2\] Area of minor segment: \[A_{\text{segment}} = A_{\text{sector}} - A_{\Delta} = \dfrac{100\pi}{3} - 25\sqrt{3} = \dfrac{100\pi - 75\sqrt{3}}{3}\text{ cm}^2\]
solution.ar:
خطوات الحل التفصيلية: (a) Use the cosine rule in triangle \(OAB\) with \(OA = OB = 10\) and \(\angle AOB = \tfrac{2\pi}{3} = 120^\circ\): \[AB^2 = 10^2 + 10^2 - 2(10)(10)\cos\left(\tfrac{2\pi}{3}\right) = 100 + 100 - 200\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right) = 200 + 100 = 300\] Thus \(AB = \sqrt{300} = 10\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}\).
(b) Area of sector \(OAB\): \[A_{\text{sector}} = \dfrac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \dfrac{1}{2}(10^2)\left(\tfrac{2\pi}{3}\right) = \dfrac{100\pi}{3}\text{ cm}^2\] Area of triangle \(OAB\): \[A_{\Delta} = \dfrac{1}{2}r^2\sin\theta = \dfrac{1}{2}(10^2)\sin\left(\tfrac{2\pi}{3}\right) = 50\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) = 25\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}^2\] Area of minor segment: \[A_{\text{segment}} = A_{\text{sector}} - A_{\Delta} = \dfrac{100\pi}{3} - 25\sqrt{3} = \dfrac{100\pi - 75\sqrt{3}}{3}\text{ cm}^2\]

question.en: [Practice 3 · Hard] A sector of a circle with radius \(r\) cm has a perimeter of \(P\) cm. The area of the sector is \(A\) cm\(^2\). Prove that \(P^2 \ge 16A\).
question.ar: حل المسألة التالية في (Circular Measure): [Practice 3 · Hard] A sector of a circle with radius \(r\) cm has a perimeter of \(P\) cm. The area of the sector is \(A\) cm\(^2\). Prove that \(P^2 \ge 16A\).

hints.en: Let the angle of the sector be \(\theta\) radians. The arc length of the sector is \(r\theta\). The perimeter \(P = 2r + r\theta\). The area \(A = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\). We need to prove \(P^2 \ge 16A\). Substituting the expressions for \(P\) and \(A\): \((2r + r\theta)^2 \ge 16 \left(\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\right)\).
hints.ar: ليكن the angle of the sector be \(\theta\) radians. The arc length of the sector is \(r\theta\). The perimeter \(P = 2r + r\theta\). The area \(A = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\). We need to prove \(P^2 \ge 16A\). Substituting the expressions for \(P\) and \(A\): \((2r + r\theta)^2 \ge 16 \left(\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\right)\).

hints.en: Rewrite and simplify to obtain: \(r^2(2 + \theta)^2 \ge 8r^2\theta\) Since \(r^2\) is positive, we can divide both sides by \(r^2\): \((2 + \theta)^2 \ge 8\theta\) \(4 + 4\theta + \theta^2 \ge 8\theta\) \(\theta^2 - 4\theta + 4 \ge 0\) \((\theta - 2)^2 \ge 0\).
hints.ar: أعد كتابة العلاقة وبسّطها للحصول على: \(r^2(2 + \theta)^2 \ge 8r^2\theta\) Since \(r^2\) is positive, we can اقسم الطرفين على \(r^2\): \((2 + \theta)^2 \ge 8\theta\) \(4 + 4\theta + \theta^2 \ge 8\theta\) \(\theta^2 - 4\theta + 4 \ge 0\) \((\theta - 2)^2 \ge 0\).

hints.en: This inequality is always true for any real value of \(\theta\). Since \(\theta\) represents an angle in a sector, it must be non-negative. Thus, the inequality \(P^2 \ge 16A\) holds true for all valid sector angles \(\theta \ge 0\). A sector angle must be less than \(2\pi\) radians. The derivation shows the inequality is always true, irrespective of the specific angle value within the valid range of a sector.

\[(2r + r\theta)^2 \ge 16 \left(\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\right)\]
\[r^2(2 + \theta)^2 \ge 8r^2\theta\]
Since \(r^2\) is positive, we can divide both sides by \(r^2\):
\[(2 + \theta)^2 \ge 8\theta\]
\[4 + 4\theta + \theta^2 \ge 8\theta\]
\[\theta^2 - 4\theta + 4 \ge 0\]
\[(\theta - 2)^2 \ge 0\]
This inequality is always true for any real value of \(\theta\). Since \(\theta\) represents an angle in a sector, it must be non-negative. Thus, the inequality \(P^2 \ge 16A\) holds true for all valid sector angles \(\theta \ge 0\). A sector angle must be less than \(2\pi\) radians. The derivation shows the inequality is always true, irrespective of the specific angle value within the valid range of a sector.

label.en: ● Complete Guide to All 6 Trigonometric Ratios — Unit Circle, Reciprocals, Domains, Periods & Asymptotes
label.ar: ● الدليل الشامل للنسب المثلثية الست — دائرة الوحدة والمقلوبات والمجالات والدورات وخطوط التقارب

body.en:
For any angle \( heta\) in standard position whose terminal ray intersects the unit circle \(x^2 + y^2 = 1\) at \(P(\cos heta, \sin heta)\) (or a right triangle with opposite \(o\), adjacent \(a\), and hypotenuse \(h\)), the six trigonometric functions are:

\[ \sin heta = y = rac{o}{h}, \qquad \cos heta = x = rac{a}{h}, \qquad an heta = rac{\sin heta}{\cos heta} = rac{y}{x} = rac{o}{a} \]\[ \csc heta = rac{1}{\sin heta} = rac{h}{o}, \qquad \sec heta = rac{1}{\cos heta} = rac{h}{a}, \qquad \cot heta = rac{\cos heta}{\sin heta} = rac{x}{y} = rac{a}{o} \]
FunctionDomainRangePeriodSymmetryVertical Asymptotes
\(\sin heta\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([-1, 1]\)\(2\pi\)OddNone
\(\cos heta\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([-1, 1]\)\(2\pi\)EvenNone
\( an heta\)\( heta eq rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\pi\)Odd\( heta = rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)
\(\csc heta\)\( heta eq k\pi\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(2\pi\)Odd\( heta = k\pi\)
\(\sec heta\)\( heta eq rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(2\pi\)Even\( heta = rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)
\(\cot heta\)\( heta eq k\pi\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\pi\)Odd\( heta = k\pi\)

Pythagorean Identities: \(\sin^2 heta + \cos^2 heta = 1\), \(1 + an^2 heta = \sec^2 heta\), and \(1 + \cot^2 heta = \csc^2 heta\).
body.ar:
لأي زاوية \( heta\) في الوضع القياسي يقطع ضلع انتهائها دائرة الوحدة \(x^2 + y^2 = 1\) عند النقطة \(P(\cos heta, \sin heta)\) (أو في مثلث قائم الزاوية بمقابل \(o\) ومجاور \(a\) ووتر \(h\))، تُعرَّف الدوال المثلثية الست كما يلي:

\[ \sin heta = y = rac{o}{h}, \qquad \cos heta = x = rac{a}{h}, \qquad an heta = rac{\sin heta}{\cos heta} = rac{y}{x} = rac{o}{a} \]\[ \csc heta = rac{1}{\sin heta} = rac{h}{o}, \qquad \sec heta = rac{1}{\cos heta} = rac{h}{a}, \qquad \cot heta = rac{\cos heta}{\sin heta} = rac{x}{y} = rac{a}{o} \]
الدالةالمجالالمدىالدورة الأساسيةالتماثلخطوط التقارب الرأسية
\(\sin heta\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([-1, 1]\)\(2\pi\)فرديةلا يوجد
\(\cos heta\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([-1, 1]\)\(2\pi\)زوجيةلا يوجد
\( an heta\)\( heta eq rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\pi\)فردية\( heta = rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)
\(\csc heta\)\( heta eq k\pi\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(2\pi\)فردية\( heta = k\pi\)
\(\sec heta\)\( heta eq rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(2\pi\)زوجية\( heta = rac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\)
\(\cot heta\)\( heta eq k\pi\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\pi\)فردية\( heta = k\pi\)

متطابقات فيثاغورس المثلثية: \(\sin^2 heta + \cos^2 heta = 1\)، و\(1 + an^2 heta = \sec^2 heta\)، و\(1 + \cot^2 heta = \csc^2 heta\).

label.en: ● All 6 Inverse Trigonometric Functions — Restricted Domains & Principal Ranges
label.ar: ● الدوال المثلثية العكسية الست جميعاً — المجالات المقيدة والمدى الأساسي

body.en:
Because the six trigonometric functions are periodic, they are not one-to-one on \(\mathbb{R}\). Restricting each forward function to its canonical principal branch makes it strictly monotonic so that a unique inverse exists (whose graph is the reflection of the restricted branch across \(y = x\)):

Inverse FunctionEquivalent StatementDomain of \(f^{-1}(x)\)Principal Range (Radians)Unit Circle Quadrants
\(y = \arcsin x = \sin^{-1} x\)\(\sin y = x\)\([-1, 1]\)\(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\)Quadrants IV & I
\(y = \arccos x = \cos^{-1} x\)\(\cos y = x\)\([-1, 1]\)\([0, \pi]\)Quadrants I & II
\(y = \arctan x = \tan^{-1} x\)\(\tan y = x\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\)Quadrants IV & I
\(y = \operatorname{arccsc} x = \csc^{-1} x\)\(\csc y = x\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, 0\right) \cup \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\)Quadrants IV & I
\(y = \operatorname{arcsec} x = \sec^{-1} x\)\(\sec y = x\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \cup \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right]\)Quadrants I & II
\(y = \operatorname{arccot} x = \cot^{-1} x\)\(\cot y = x\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((0, \pi)\)Quadrants I & II

Reciprocal & Cofunction Identities: \(\operatorname{arccsc}(x) = \arcsin(1/x)\) and \(\operatorname{arcsec}(x) = \arccos(1/x)\) for \(|x| \ge 1\); \(\arcsin x + \arccos x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) and \(\arctan x + \operatorname{arccot} x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
body.ar:
نظراً لأن الدوال المثلثية الست دورية، فإنها ليست متباينة (واحداً لواحد) على \(\mathbb{R}\). بتقييد مجال كل دالة إلى فرعها الأساسي تصبح رتيبة تماماً وقابلة للعكس، ويكون تمثيل الدالة العكسية انعكاساً للفرع المقيّد حول المستقيم \(y = x\):

الدالة العكسيةالصيغة المكافئةمجال \(f^{-1}(x)\)المدى الأساسي (بالراديان)أرباع دائرة الوحدة
\(y = \arcsin x = \sin^{-1} x\)\(\sin y = x\)\([-1, 1]\)\(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\)الربعان الرابع والأول
\(y = \arccos x = \cos^{-1} x\)\(\cos y = x\)\([-1, 1]\)\([0, \pi]\)الربعان الأول والثاني
\(y = \arctan x = \tan^{-1} x\)\(\tan y = x\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\)الربعان الرابع والأول
\(y = \operatorname{arccsc} x = \csc^{-1} x\)\(\csc y = x\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, 0\right) \cup \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\)الربعان الرابع والأول
\(y = \operatorname{arcsec} x = \sec^{-1} x\)\(\sec y = x\)\((-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)\)\(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \cup \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right]\)الربعان الأول والثاني
\(y = \operatorname{arccot} x = \cot^{-1} x\)\(\cot y = x\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((0, \pi)\)الربعان الأول والثاني

متطابقات المقلوبات والدوال المتممة: \(\operatorname{arccsc}(x) = \arcsin(1/x)\) و\(\operatorname{arcsec}(x) = \arccos(1/x)\) لكل \(|x| \ge 1\)؛ وكذلك \(\arcsin x + \arccos x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) و\(\arctan x + \operatorname{arccot} x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
